verdict.rationale: Privacy posture, including keeping user data out of model training, is a fair question for an agent framework and its Studio app, since a buyer might ask about telemetry or data-use controls. However, nothing in the evidence pack addresses data-use policies, training opt-outs, telemetry controls, or privacy guarantees. The docs cover only agents, teams, memory, logging and Studio features, so the applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
